caption: This shio broth, clear and golden-brown with gentle ripples, sits in a white ceramic bowl with red rim and green dragon pattern. Tender chashu pork and a pink spiral naruto fish cake float in the glossy soup on a wooden table with warm brown tones.

segments_info.text: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle light reflections.
Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with slight fat marbling and a glossy surface, cut into a curved, irregular shape.
The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-brown, and glossy, with thin noodles submerged and floating, showing gentle ripples on its surface.
White ceramic bowl with red rim, green dragon pattern, and red Chinese characters around its edge.
Naruto fish cake: white base with pink spiral swirl, scalloped edge, smooth surface, slightly translucent.
